links.outcome: Subgroup disparities in ICU outcomes and predicted treatment effects by age and race
links.effect: Age: 5.1pp mortality disparity; predicted treatment effects 3.2pp younger vs 1.8pp older. Race: severity-adjusted disparities averaged 2.2pp, reaching 5.6pp at high severity, despite similar aggregate outcomes.
links.quote: For race-based analysis, severity-adjusted outcome disparities (average 2.2pp, reaching 5.6pp at high severity) suggest potential differences in care quality or algorithmic recommendations despite similar aggregate outcomes.

unlisted_practices: Doubly-robust statistical framework for auditing treatment recommendation disparities using multiple fairness metrics (demographic parity, equalized odds, calibration)

screen.reason: Empirically tests and demonstrates a doubly-robust bias auditing framework on ICU patient data to detect demographic disparities in treatment recommendation AI systems prior to deployment.
